description.value: Rollzzy is a fast-casual Indian street food chain specializing in authentic Kathi Rolls — handmade paratha wraps filled with spiced meats, paneer, and vegetarian fillings rooted in Kolkata street food tradition. The Robson Street location is part of a growing Lower Mainland franchise (TGI Foods Corp) with over 20 roll varieties plus momos, Indian-style burgers, and chai. Cyclists touring downtown Vancouver will find it a quick, customizable stop with a wide range of vegetarian and vegan options.
